source_refs.note: Ovaries: a main subheading of 16.2.7 Gonads, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 67-67.

blocks.text: Ovaries zanana sex hormones, yani estrogen aur progesterone, chhorti hain:

items: Estrogen Graafian follicle (pakka hua follicle) FSH ke jawab mein chhorta hai. Is ke kaam: secondary sexual characteristics (sanvi jinsi khasusiyat) ki nashonuma, maslan chhatiyon ka barhna, pelvis (koolhe ki haddi) ka chaura hona, koolhon aur raanon par charbi ka phailao; menstrual cycle (haiz ka chakkar) ko qaboo karna; haiz ke baad uterus ki andaruni teh ki marammat; ovulation (ovary se anda nikalna); haddiyon ki mazbooti (bone density) qaim rakhna; "bura" cholesterol (LDL) kam karna; blood pressure sehatmand rakhna; mizaj aur yaaddasht ko qaboo karna.

blocks.title: For Information: puberty (balooghat)
blocks.text: Puberty nau-jawani ka woh daur hai jis mein sex organs pukhta hote hain aur secondary sex characteristics zahir hoti hain. Mardon mein sperm banna shuru hota hai, awaz bhaari hoti hai, seena chaura hota hai aur jism aur chehre par baal ugte hain. Auraton mein menstrual cycle shuru hota hai, chhatiyan barhti hain aur koolhe chaure hote hain.

items: Progesterone menstrual cycle ke dauran corpus luteum LH ke jawab mein banata hai. Hamal (pregnancy) mein placenta bhi ise banata aur chhorta hai. Yeh pituitary se mazeed FSH ka chhootna rokta hai, is liye mazeed follicles nahin pakte. Yeh hamal qaim rakhne ke liye uterus ki deewar ko mazeed mota aur khoon ki nalyon se bhar deta hai (vascularisation). Progesterone ovulation ko dabata hai.

blocks.title: For Information: doosre zariye
blocks.text:
Adrenal glands bhi thori miqdar mein estrogen aur testosterone chhorte hain.
Auraton mein bhi bohat thora testosterone banta hai.
